definitions.explanation: A wide field of view, most commonly used in photography and optics. Refers to lenses or camera settings that capture a broader scene than a standard lens.

examples.japanese: {広角|こうかく}⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}した→撮影する：21990_satsueisuru⟧。
examples.english: I shot it with a wide-angle lens.

examples.japanese: {広角|こうかく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{写|うつ}る→写る：11494_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: When you shoot wide-angle, the scenery appears broader.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広角|こうかく}⟦モード→モード：11596_moodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{搭載|とうさい}→搭載：12789_tousai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This smartphone's camera has a wide-angle mode.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {広|こう} (wide, broad) + {角|かく} (angle). Almost exclusively used in photography and optics contexts. Most commonly appears in the compound {広角|こうかく}⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧ (wide-angle lens).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広角|こうかく}⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧ (wide-angle lens)
- {広角|こうかく}⟦モード→モード：11596_moodo⟧ (wide-angle mode)
- ⟦{超|ちょう}→超〜：28619_chou⟧{広角|こうかく} (ultra-wide-angle)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{望遠|ぼうえん}→望遠：15552_bouen⟧: telephoto — the opposite end of the focal range, for distant subjects
- ⟦{標準|ひょうじゅん}→標準：04832_hyoujun⟧: standard — a standard focal length, between wide-angle and telephoto
